messages:
maggie: Hey folks — trying to land PR #8421 (migration guide + SDK snippet). docs-ci preview failed, need a quick hand, aiming for a late merge slot tonight PST.
ben: pinging in case you're online. what's failing?
ci-bot: CI summary: docs-preview failed (linkcheck, vale, mdlint). See logs: https://ci.redwood/example/8421
maggie: pasted the important bits from the preview log:
```
vale  ERROR  rules/HeadingCase.V001: Prefer sentence case for headings: 'Using the Redwood API' -> 'Using the Redwood API' (file: migration/kv-cache.md)
linkcheck ERROR  broken anchor: ./migration/kv-cache.md#kv-cache-implementation -> anchor not found
mdlint WARN    line-length: guides/optimization.md:45 (82 > 80)
```
ash: I can fix the anchor — looks like the target heading was renamed to "KV cache implementation" but anchor generated as `kv-cache-implementation` vs `kv-cache`.
ash: quick patch: update the link to `#kv-cache-implementation` and push.
sam: I can tweak heading casing too, but we should avoid changing too many files in one PR. If it's just the heading in kv-cache.md, fine.
maggie: thanks. I'll open a tiny follow-up commit with the link change + heading case tweak. who can approve after CI passes? need someone to merge in the 11pm PST slot.
ben: I can do the final approval + merge once docs-bot shows a green preview. @sam can you sanity-check the SDK snippet after I +1?
sam: yep, will look after rerun.
docs-bot: Received rerun request from maggie. Queueing preview rebuild...
ci-bot: Rebuild started by docs-bot (preview-id: pr-8421-pt2)
ci-bot: Rebuild finished: linkcheck=ok, mdlint=ok, vale=ok — preview staging URL: https://preview.redwood/pr/8421
maggie: pushed fix: 089f3ab (link + heading case)
ben: looked at preview, SDK snippet renders fine. +1 from me. I'll merge at 23:05 PST unless any objections.
sam: no objections on my side. small nit: consider wrapping code sample in triple backticks to preserve indentation next time.
maggie: great, thanks everyone :tada:
ben: merged and backported to staging. good job — enjoy the late merge slot.
notes: short thread coordinating CI fixes and merge slot — small code/markdown fixes + rerun
